Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

BULKHEAD ELBOW COUPLING ASSEMBLY FOR 

OIL-HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS 



1 Scope — Specifies the dimensions and other requirements for bulkhead elbow coupling assembly 
used in oil-hydrauhc systems 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1 

3. Assembly Details — A bulkhead coupling assembly consists of ferrules ( conforming to 
IS 8802-1978 'Specification for ferrules for oil-hydrauhc couplings' ), coupling nut ( conforming to 
IS 8803-1978 'Specification for coupling nuts for oil-hydrauhc couplings' ), lock nut [conforming to 
'Indian Standard Specification for lock nuts for oil-hydraulic couplings ( under preparation) ] and 
bulkhead elbow body conforming to IS 9757 ( Part I )-198l Specification for bulkhead elbow body 
for oil-hydrauhc couplings, Part I Made from forgmgs' or 'Indian Standard Specification for bulkhead 
elbow body made from bar stock ( under preparation )> as agreed to between the user and the 
manufacturer 

4. General Requirements — For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to 
IS 8805( Part I )-1978 'General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic 
systems Part I General' 

5. Designation — A bulkhead elbow coupling assembly of light series L for outside diameter of 
tube 6 mm and conforming to this standard shall be designated as 

Bulkhead Elbow Coupling L6 IS 9770 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following standards 

BS 4368 Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes 

Part 1 1972 Heavy series (metric ) 

Part 3 : 1974 Light series ( metric ) British Standards Institution ( BSI ) 

DIN 2353-1966 Non-soldered taper-bush type pipe unions, complete unions and survey. 
Deutsches Institut fu> Normung ( DIN )
